crossRefs.note: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill…
So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.
They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of…
Yahweh heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,
“Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,
Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of…
For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb…
‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to…
You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them…

people.name: Kadesh
people.line: An important oasis in the Wilderness of Zin

people.name: Zered
people.line: A brook marking the end of Israel's wilderness wanderings

translations.web: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years: until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as Yahweh swore to them.
translations.bsb: The time we spent traveling from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the Brook of Zered was thirty-eight years, until that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.
translations.kjv: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware
translations.asv: And the days in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, were thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the midst of the camp, as Jehovah sware unto them.
